conventions.sweep_cumulative: angle between the spanwise vertical through the root reference point and the line from it to the same reference point at that station, positive aft
conventions.rake: leading-edge offset out of the planform plane, +Z
conventions.dihedral: same construction as the sweep but on the rake, positive toward +Z; the wing name for propeller rake angle
conventions.twist: angle of the section chord line, positive nose-up
conventions.tilt: slope of the chord line in the span direction from the LE and TE heights: tilt_ratio = (y_te - y) / (x_te - x_le), tilt = arctan(tilt_ratio), positive TE up; 0 on a horizontal section
conventions.shape_parameters: normalised by the local chord, measured in the section's own chord-aligned frame so twist does not leak into thickness or camber
conventions.tolerances: decide only how a distribution is labelled; the tabulated values are the raw measurements
conventions.fit_rows: fits, the planform summary and the local (tangent) columns use the horizontal sections only

columns.name: chord
columns.description: true LE->TE length in the section plane

columns.name: sweep_le
columns.description: cumulative LE sweep from the root LE, positive aft

columns.name: rake
columns.description: LE offset out of the planform plane (propeller rake)

columns.name: dihedral
columns.description: cumulative dihedral / rake angle, positive toward +Z

columns.name: twist
columns.description: section twist / pitch angle, positive nose-up

columns.name: x_cmax
columns.description: x/c of maximum camber, NaN on a symmetric section

columns.name: y_te
columns.description: trailing-edge height; equal to y except on the tilted tip section

columns.name: tilt_ratio
columns.description: (y_te - y) / (x_te - x_le), rise of the chord line over its run

columns.name: tilt
columns.description: section tilt about the thickness axis, arctan(tilt_ratio), positive TE up

summary.note: integrals cover the horizontal sections only, root up to the top horizontal station; the tilted tip section and anything above it are not included

stack_layout.te_top_how: top of the b-rep trailing-edge curve

tip_section.definition: planar cut through the top of the LE and the top of the TE, tilted about the thickness axis; shape parameters are those of its own airfoil, measured untilted

tip_cap.definition: the part above the tilted tip section: an inclined face over the tip section, face(u) = h_le (1-u) + h_te u + 3u(1-u) [b1 (1-u) + b2 u], crowned across the thickness with radius crown_radius (top of the cap H = face + w^2 / (2 crown_radius), w = the tip section's half-thickness), a constant edge_radius joining the side walls to the crown and rounding the LE end, and te_radius rounding the TE end; model in tip_cap.py
tip_cap.frame: u = x / chord along the tip section's chord from the top of the LE; heights above the tip section's plane along its normal; lengths in mm

fit.note: distance from the CAD cap's cross-section points to the model's

xcad.note: loops over the cap after the stack, each at a fixed fraction of the local cap height, starting at the top of the LE like the sections; they all meet the tip section at the top of the LE and the top of the TE

tip_tilt_deg.axis: thickness (+Z in the working frame, -Y in the XCAD file)
tip_tilt_deg.sign: positive raises the TE end of the tip section
tip_tilt_deg.note: tilt of the tip section, the last section of the stack; a design variable in the optimisation stage
tip_tilt_deg.pivot: top of the LE, the end of the b-rep leading-edge curve

cap_face_inclination_deg.definition: inclination of the cap's face relative to the tip section, arctan((h_te - h_le) / chord); changing it moves h_te with h_le and the bow held

cap_edge_radius_mm.definition: edge radius joining the side walls to the cap's crown, also rounding the cap's LE end

cap_fixed.note: cap parameters held fixed for now
